pages.title: Where It All Begins
pages.text: The Protocol Anchor Core is the foundation of the entire industrial system. It's the primary generator and starting point of the power grid.$(br2)Generation: 200 $(efu)$(br)Internal Battery: 100,000 $(efu)$(br)Clearance: 9x9 (no other blocks allowed)

pages.title: Placement Rules
pages.text: The Protocol Core requires a 9x9 clear area. No blocks (including grass, flowers, etc.) may occupy this space.$(br2)You automatically receive one when first joining a world. If lost, you can re-craft it at a Crafter.$(br2)Once placed, the core cannot be picked up (it can be broken but won't drop). Choose your location carefully!

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: The Protocol Core continuously generates 200 $(efu) of power. This is distributed through the grid to all connected devices.$(br2)Surplus power charges the internal battery (max 100,000 $(efu)).$(br2)If demand exceeds generation, stored power is automatically released from the battery to cover the shortfall.
